name: lens-magnify-text
title: Lens Magnify Text
description: A circular lens that magnifies the text beneath it using a duplicated, scaled copy clipped to a circle that tracks the pointer — a magnifier, not a highlight, with true enlargement of glyph detail.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Pointer Lens: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
